reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM competitor_prices cp WHERE cp.product_id = p.product_id)
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM products
WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE cp.product_id IS NULL

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE cp.product_id IS NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A LEFT JOIN and a test for a missing match finds the same products, but NOT EXISTS states the question directly.
